business_summary: Tekken Corporation engages in the civil engineering and construction work business in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Civil Engineering, Architectural Construction, Real Estate, Incidental Business, and Other segments. The company develops social infrastructure projects, such as roads, tunnels, bridges, water supply and sewage systems, and riverbank revetments; railroad infrastructure, including railway viaducts, bridges, tunnels, stations, station buildings, and railyards; and construction buildings, such as condominiums, schools, and medical and welfare facilities. It is also involved in real estate development and leasing; building renovation; consulting services; agriculture, renewable energy, and early paulownia afforestation; sale of construction equipment and environmental products; non-life insurance agency; security services; machinery rental; temporary staffing; administrative outsourcing; manufacture, sale, and transportation of materials and machinery for civil engineering and construction work; and rental and repair of machinery for civil engineering and construction work. In addition, the company provides construction and technical guidance for civil engineering and building work; planning and consulting services for civil engineering and construction projects; training and education services for architectural engineering; and business support services for construction works. Further, it engages in the planning, development, production, and sale of publications, printed materials, videos, and digital content; provision of civil engineering construction management services; operation of strawberry tourist farm; and supply and sale of electricity generated from small wood biomass gasification power and small-scale hydropower. Tekken Corporation was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Tekken Corporation은 일본, 아시아 및 해외에서 토목 및 건설 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 토목 공학, 건축 건설, 부동산, 부수 사업 및 기타 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 도로, 터널, 교량, 상하수도 시스템, 강둑 호안과 같은 사회 기반 시설 프로젝트를 개발합니다. 철도 고가교, 교량, 터널, 역, 역 건물 및 철로를 포함한 철도 인프라; 콘도미니엄, 학교, 의료 및 복지 시설 등의 건축용 건물. 또한 부동산 개발 및 임대에도 참여하고 있습니다. 건물 개조; 컨설팅 서비스; 농업, 재생에너지, 초기 오동나무 조림; 건설 장비 및 환경 제품 판매; 손해보험대리점; 보안 서비스; 기계 대여; 임시 인력 배치; 관리 아웃소싱; 토목공사 및 건축공사에 필요한 자재 및 기계의 제조, 판매 및 운송; 토목공사 및 건축공사를 위한 기계의 임대 및 수리. 또한 회사는 C에 대한 구축 및 기술지도를 제공합니다.
